G57 written into notes-D3.md after G56's readings (D3a-53), before any of P19's 787 lines is read or ruled. P19 is shown when a concept shows one room's work, or a wish to place one, inside another room's mark or territory, with the other room as the one that may allow it. Forms: AS (asking the host for room or leave), PR (a small room counting on or seeking a bigger room's protection, or listed among a host's protected works), RU (the host rules on requests: approves, denies, sets conditions, publishes rules, lists approved works, votes, removes unapproved works), DI (contest over whether approval is needed, who gives it, or whether it holds). Marks: HO (this room hosts), GU (this room is the guest), OE, VE (G18), CO (a colour-faith host), AC, PO. Not shown by: side-by-side borders and deals (P08), a single grant with no request or rule (T3-012), help or bartered help and mutual defence of equals (P16, P17), a coalition with no host and guest (P17), the host sub's moderation (P20), who may commit the room (P21) unless the agreement is who builds in whose space, open space or who held a spot first (T3-020, T3-045), pleas to attackers (P07), a colour professed with no ruling on guests (K04). Absent lines under G2 and G3; restrict under G9, with §2's trigger for corrections met twice; add and link lines under G4a. Census rules before the census; the status ruling weighs whether the host's rule shows or most rooms only ask, the overlap with P08, P16 and P17, colour-faith hosts, and F-012's reverse order. Draws (G1b) from verb offset 505: packets of 100, 100 and 17. Next: the draws

G1b draws for P19 by d3_sample_packet.py (d3_draw_P19_505, _605, _705; ten lines each, seed 20261016 plus the offset; headers confirm 100, 100 and 17 instantiate lines). In each draw the quotes agree with the ruling the how and labels would get under G57; no drawn line is unsupported in G1b's sense. The draws show the four forms: guests asking a host for room or leave (bostonceltics, giivasunner, sadboys, danganronpa, de, theexpanse, weezer's calvinandhobbes visitor), hosts ruling with conditions or refusals (archlinux's PrequelMemes visitor, factorio's archlinux and CKII visitors, theexpanse, traaaaaaannnnnnnnnns, yugioh, xcom, yumenikki's Sweden), protection promised by a bigger room (malta and France, yogscast and the Blue Corner, rocketbeans and placestart), and members asking whether approval was given (greyblob, warframe, starcitizen). Many guests apply to colour-faith hosts (GreenLattice, the Blue Corner, ainbowroad) and to national flags (France, Sweden, Thailand, de). As in D3a-52, every packet is read whole in windows of 25 lines, so the draws decide nothing on their own. Next: windows i505_000 and i505_025

G57's reading 1, stated while reading P19's instantiate window i505_000 (25 lines), before its rows are written; not an amendment. (1) A guest's request in the host's thread is AS, marked VE for the visitor, and the host's answer is RU, marked OE and HO (2007scape c0591, c0611; AvoArmy c0229, c0099; FloydVsVoid c0115, c0117; SquareSpiral c0094, c0106). In the guest's own room, a member's plan to ask a host, an application, or a report of the host's permission, refusal or condition is AS or RU, marked GU (GuildWars2 c0120; aceattorney c0096; Jamaica c0029, c0047; OnePiece c0034; Peru c0046, c0069; Fez c0080). (2) A condition on the grant (upkeep, help with the host's work, a colour, a size) is part of RU; help or upkeep given in exchange for room inside the host's ground is P19, not P16 alone, since the guest's work lives in that ground (TeamYellowPlace c0051; AmericanFlaginPlace c0390; SwissNeutralityZone c0072). Protection promised or sought for the guest's work is PR (Goodboye c0020; TheFarLeftSide c0417; ainbowroad c1341). (3) A host's charge that a guest built without asking or after a refusal, a dispute over what the approval covered, and a third room's claim against an agreed spot are DI (AcePlace c0090; PurplePixels c0215; adventuretime c0122; Moondye7 c0044, c0045). (4) A host that is a colour or pattern faction is CO (GreenLattice in OnePiece and Peru; GreenCorner c0100; PurplePixels; SquareSpiral; TeamYellowPlace; ainbowroad; TheFarLeftSide); national flags and a school conference host as well (PlaceNL c0080, c0081; SwissNeutralityZone; AmericanFlaginPlace; TheB1G c0015). (5) A guest's thanks for being hosted reports that the ruling held, and shows RU (2007scape c0512; AcePlace c0092). Next: P19-inst-spec-1.txt

G57's reading 2, stated while reading P19's instantiate window i505_025 (25 lines), before its rows are written; not an amendment. (1) A host's published rule, with or without exceptions, a vote on an applicant, a choice between two applicants for one spot, and a government for its side of the canvas are RU (catalonia c0042, c0044; catalunya c0052, c0057; albania c0053, after the close, AC; babymetal c0178; catholicism c0091). (2) A place inside a host's work bought with labour for that work (clubpenguin c0091, placestart's taskbar), with upkeep of the host's flag (catalonia c0014), or with a line reconnected (buffalobills c0016) is RU, and protection sought in the same offer is PR. A work on a host's list of authorized flags, under a third room's ban on touching the host's zone, is PR (bretagne c0016). (3) A visitor from the host who rules in the guest's room is VE and the room GU (archlinux c0011, c0012; anarcho_capitalism c0129, c0132; canucks c0104; chibears c0091). A member who asks whether the room had leave, or warns that unapproved works are deleted, is DI (berkeley c0095 answered in c0096; canucks c0105, c0128). (4) A member asking the room's own flag defenders for a personal piece on the room's flag is P02, not P19; a visiting room's request on the same flag is P19 (brasil c0327 against c0447). (5) An invitation to a team to take an open space beside the room's work, on a border condition, is P08 and open space, not P19 (cfb c0568). Next: P19-inst-spec-2.txt

G57's reading 3, stated while reading P19's instantiate window i505_050 (25 lines), before its rows are written; not an amendment. (1) A guest's member who holds the room to a host's leave, or plans to take a request to the host, shows AS (czech c0251, c0252; dbz c0102; enterthegungeon c0061). (2) A host's colour condition (blend into blue, keep the area below blue, keep the border blue, members taking the blue side) is RU, and the host is CO (fireemblem c0306; enterthegungeon c0035; elitedangerous c0061; dbz c0128). (3) A host that fits guests' icons into its own template, and asks them to build to it, is RU (earthbound c0079, c0046; placestart). (4) A host's breach of its own rules, a guest's admission that it takes sovereign space, and a host's charge that a guest built unasked are DI (dragonquest c0059, c0063; edboxes c0052, c0053). (5) A member's redirect to the sub's sticky, in answer to a visitor's request, is P20; the request alone shows P19 in the host's record, marked VE (darksouls c0182, c0183). (6) A member's wish for a colour of their own in the room's flag is P02 (de c0457), beside visitors' requests that show P19. (7) Protection promised inside the host's ground is PR (daftpunk c0045; evex c0013). Next: P19-inst-spec-3.txt
